pr_med.body:
## Scope
Purely synthetic, research-grade numerical baseline; no patient data or clinical claim. Scope/budget issue #3. MED-001 remains OPEN; no main merge requested.

## Results and preserved negative evidence
15 seed/site cells,11520 invented rows: calibration256/test512 for five seeds and three sites. Held-out mean Brier changes after calibration: reference +0.001416 (worse; seed-level interval[-0.000905,0.003737]); intercept shift -0.068089 ([-0.076873,-0.059304]); measurement shift -0.012857 ([-0.018338,-0.007377]). These intervals describe this frozen synthetic experiment only, not external medical performance. All original raw CSV files, exact generator/analysis, source records, hashes and negative results are included.

Independent verifier checks1996 quantities with maximum difference7.77e-16. It independently replays the synthetic generator, uses an alternate scipy least_squares score solver rather than the author's Newton routine, and recomputes pairwise AUC/AP, Brier, calibration/reliability, toy net benefit and seed-based intervals. Two tampering controls reject. Subgroup metrics and conditional row-level intervals were not independently verified; evidence limits are explicit. Same frozen data, not independent clinical evidence.

## Provenance and reproducibility
Frozen specification SHA256 cb8e12aad804940aac4f4db855b1a62302f6abc372a9210f9baaf25939e5dfdd. Exact tree2135e31d2f2e2c2331e6eec6f61349b3a84cd5e5 matches locally validated candidate8989090c7a16d9fa8ab4f60fef440f3cc0b8c072; connector commit00a4d7f81b47fd96b2a7e4ce3ca8059676697c97 changes publication metadata only. Local admission preceded computation; delayed full repository publication is not prospective public preregistration.

See runs/20261009T105245957548Z-gpt-MED-001 and problems/MED-001 for source, environment, commands, raw evidence and independently written verification code. Pinned governance validation/check-diff passed locally; exact-head CI pending. This baseline does not support diagnosis, treatment, clinical deployment, biological mechanism or broad problem completion.
